value.name: Lucia hesitates before responding
value.description: Lucia pauses, then speaks in a much smaller voice than before, signaling a shift from defiance to uncertainty.
evidence: Lucia spoke first, finally, in a voice that was much smaller than the voice in which she had said she would not accept.

value.name: Lucia worries about affording the house
value.description: Lucia asks Rosa what happens if she cannot afford to buy the house, revealing financial fear beneath the inheritance decision.
evidence: "Rosa," she said. "What if I cannot afford the house either."

value.name: Rosa explains the choice is not about the house
value.description: Rosa reassures Lucia that the house is secondary and explains that the codicil was meant to preserve Lucia's freedom to choose without financial pressure.
evidence: "Then your brother will keep it," Rosa said, "and you and I will visit. Or your brother will not keep it and we will all leave. The house is not the point. The room is not the point. The point is that your mother wanted you to choose. The codicil made it possible for you to choose. I am trying to make it possible for you to choose without being crushed by money. That is all I am trying to do."

value.name: Lucia asks Daniel if he wants the house
value.description: Lucia turns to Daniel and directly asks whether he wants the house, shifting the decision to him.

value.name: Daniel admits uncertainty about his desire
value.description: After a long silence, Daniel says he does not yet know what he wants and asks for time to figure it out before the deadline.
evidence: "I wanted to sell the house," he said finally, "and I told myself that was the same as wanting it. I think I do not know yet what I want. I think — I think I want to find out, between now and Monday week, what I want. I am asking you to let me find that out without deciding for me. I am also asking you to find out, between now and Monday week, what you want. I do not want you to tell me today. I want you to tell me when you know."

value.name: Lucia agrees to wait
value.description: Lucia accepts Daniel's request and agrees not to decide immediately.

value.name: Daniel confirms mutual agreement
value.description: Daniel echoes Lucia's acceptance, reinforcing the temporary truce between them.

value.name: Daniel declines Rosa's offer for now
value.description: Daniel turns to Rosa and says he is not accepting her offer today, signaling that the decision remains unresolved.
